department: Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences

gre_subject.value: No GRE subject test applies to this field and the program page does not ask for one.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale, with 5 in writing and speaking.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in writing and speaking.

supervisor.value: Contact potential supervisors before applying and check that they have positions and funding.
supervisor.quote: Before applying to the program, students are strongly advised to establish contact with potential supervisors.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student, international included, gets at least CAD 29,145 a year for four years; internationals also get an award covering the international tuition difference.
funding.quote: Full-time doctoral students (both domestic and international) receive minimum funding of $29,145 per year (effective May 1, 2026) for up to four years.

also.quote: International students in a full-time PhD program will be awarded an International Doctoral Student Award (IDSA)

entry_route.value: An MSc with 75% is the normal route; direct entry from a BSc only in exceptional cases.
entry_route.quote: The program is open to students who have completed a Master of Science (MSc) degree with a 75% average | in exceptional cases where a student demonstrates academic excellence

notes: Strong in groundwater hydrology and hydrogeology.
